definition: Fixed episode-close eligible complexes; upper empirical median with unreached dates at infinity. Three consecutive eligible weeks; five-week sensitivity. Unreached is not proof of failure.
limits: Selected surviving current inventory, not the entire historical market.
Quarter ties have no within-quarter rank. Durations rounded to four weeks.
No individual prices, dates, identifiers, exact cohort sizes or weights.
Different evidence policies and price targets select different complexes.
No causal or next-cycle predictive interpretation.
